distinctness_review.method: Read all 181 selected names and physical stable keys, searched sources and both research trees plus v97 entities for CyrusOne/Aurora/Diehl aliases. Shapely 2.1.2 Point intersection checked against every complete selected feature geometry, not just display anchors.

One new campus key groups CHI1-CHI3; CHI2 sound-mitigation project is a new scoped capital retrofit, not operating-campus construction or added hall. Existing Edged Chicago Aurora is distinct; QTS Aurora is in Colorado.
